command_action: mutmut 3.3.1 with setproctitle shim; candidate-only (174 tests) and combined candidate+frozen-exam (233 tests) on disposable copies, also_copy += candidate_adapter.py/api_contract.py/schemas
evidence: candidate-only 2584 mutants: 1731 killed / 543 survived / 76.1% (reliable, no timeout artifact). Combined nominal 90.23% but invalid: mutmut 3.3.1 records the teardown phase (~0.00s) as duration_by_test, so per-mutant CPU cap is ~30-60s and the frozen exam's slow property/fuzz covering sets (~110-240s) produce 442 spurious timeouts. Transition candidate-only->combined: 362 survived->timeout, 79 killed->timeout, 2 survived->killed, 0 killed->survived. Spot-checks (full covering set, --timeout=400): 8/8 former survivors survive; 1/2 former killed re-killed (exam property test found counterexample); 1 former killed now survives. Estimated true combined score ~76.2% (plausible 73-77%), never >=90%.
diagnosis: fixed candidate e319850 does not meet the frozen 90% mutation threshold under any measured test set. ~30% of survivors (~160-180 of 543) are equivalent mutants (case-only SQL/string changes, no-body-diff) that no test can kill; survivor budget for >=90% is <=227, so 90% is unreachable via additional tests alone. Contrast: pre-fix base ac283d71 measured 93.02% (1707/128, ledger 26); the fix commit that passes the frozen exam changed the mutant landscape and dropped the score below threshold.
remediation: NORMATIVE DECISION REQUIRED from human authority (cannot relax frozen invariant without authorization): (a) record mutation gate not satisfied and pause v0.1.0 finalization, (b) authorized re-scope of the mutation metric (exclude equivalent/parse_fail mutants and correct the mutmut 3.3.1 duration bug), or (c) targeted test strengthening (bounded by equivalents). Decision taken: RECORD FAIL AND PAUSE FINALIZATION.
